evidence.title: Reuters reproduced alternate Muse access on Android and macOS, with iPhone tests blocked
evidence.observation: Reuters, Signal and AI Now Institute reproduced Muse reading Signal message content via previously granted device permissions in tested Android and macOS setups. Comparable iPhone tests blocked access. Meta said permissions were explicitly granted and characterized the examples as isolated.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded observation; not independently verified by Commons
evidence.glossary_fit: Commons interpretation only; founding definitions and standings unchanged

source_locations.SRC-163: Repurposing settings; Meta response; Not my conversation

evidence.limitations: OS and setup dependent. The tests do not show compromise of Signal encryption. Reuters could not establish whether apparent cross-account information in other reports was genuine. Apple reported a macOS change limiting the tested route.
evidence.open_questions: Do approvals express informed authorization for how device permissions are used together?
evidence.support_assessment: Commons interpretation: Application-level expectations and effective local capability can differ across configurations. Wardle’s proof of concept and the Reuters tests remain separately attributed.
evidence.dispute_status: Source access, scope and generalization qualifications retained; no systematic clearance.
evidence.verification_status: Not independently verified by the Commons
